fixes.explanation: Palm branches show up in Revelation 7:9, where a great multitude stands before the throne holding them. Here the text puts something else with the incense. It's the prayers of all the saints. That's what goes with the incense on the golden altar in this verse.

Yes, baker. "A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass." That's what happens when the first angel sounds his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood are hurled down upon the earth. I've burned a batch or two myself, but never a third of the earth.

Yes, baker. "A third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well." That's what happens when the fourth angel sounds his trumpet and a third of the sun and moon and stars are struck. So a third of the day goes without light, and a third of the night does too. That's a whole lot of dark to land on one clock.
